sources.name: OS NGD Structure Features Collection
sources.role: structure collection geometry, currency and attribution contract
verified_facts: The collection includes point, line and polygon manmade structures that are not buildings.
It provides lifecycle identifiers and up-to-daily updates.
semantic_limits: Collection currency does not prove candidate-specific height completeness or legal boundary accuracy.

sources.name: OS NGD Structure Line Feature Type
verified_facts: Structure Line represents linear freestanding constructions such as barriers, pipelines or sea walls.
It is not wide enough to be represented as a structure polygon.
semantic_limits: A line feature cannot substitute for a parcel polygon or terrain raster.

sources.name: OS NGD Structure Point Feature Type
verified_facts: Structure Point represents small freestanding manmade constructions such as statues or post boxes.
Point features can carry level and lifecycle attribution.
semantic_limits: A structure point is not an elevation observation and does not locate parcel extrema.

sources.name: OS NGD Compound Structure Feature Type
verified_facts: Compound Structure combines components into a polygon representing a purpose-built construction.
The page documents schema-version timing and availability.
semantic_limits: A compound outline can aggregate components and must not be treated as seamless topography or legal extent.

sources.name: OS NGD Field Boundary Feature Type
sources.role: derived field-boundary line, identifier and classification contract
verified_facts: Field Boundary replicates all or part of an underlying Structure Line and has a structureline_osid relation.
It is classified by physical boundary type.
semantic_limits: A physical boundary line is not necessarily a cadastral legal boundary.

sources.name: Field Boundary Summary
sources.role: field-boundary source, height/width and update-cycle contract
verified_facts: Field Boundary classification uses aerial imagery, DSM, DTM and underlying structure lines.
Height and width values are created through a cyclical process with subsequent updates.
semantic_limits: Derived boundary height is not EA DTM parcel max-minus-min and cannot define legal ownership.

sources.name: Field Boundary Known Limitations
sources.role: field-boundary omission and generalisation limitations contract
verified_facts: Some vegetation-change edges are not classified as field boundaries.
Closely spaced parallel features can be generalised and one feature selected over another.
semantic_limits: Absence or selected representation must not be interpreted as proof that no physical or legal boundary exists.

sources.name: OS NGD Structures Demonstrator
sources.role: structure layers, height coverage and compound-feature demonstration contract
verified_facts: The demonstrator distinguishes structure polygon, line, point and compound layers.
Only selected structure classifications have height attribution and not every feature is populated.
semantic_limits: Demonstration content and partial height attribution cannot create parcel terrain measurements.

sources.name: Structure Point Description Code List
verified_facts: The code list defines descriptions for Structure Point features such as statues and post boxes.
It constrains feature semantics.
semantic_limits: A description value is not a survey observation, terrain height or legal-boundary indicator.

sources.name: OS NGD Land Use Theme
sources.role: land-use versus land-cover and legal-extent separation contract
verified_facts: The theme represents areas used for specific purposes and related access locations.
Site extents represent usage or function and are not definitive legal ownership extents.
semantic_limits: A land-use site must not replace an HMLR polygon or a terrain sampling boundary.
